verdict.rationale: No evidence of a simple incoming-webhook URL for posting messages; Buzz's documented posting mechanisms require Nostr keypairs and NIP-98 signed HTTP auth events (buzz-supp-admin-api, buzz-supp-git-nostr-credentials, buzz-supp-nip-aa-agent-auth) rather than a bare webhook URL, and no OpenAPI/llms.txt endpoint was found (buzz-probe-1, buzz-probe-2).
